controller_source:
from pathlib import Path
import os,json,subprocess,signal,time,sys,select
root=Path('/tmp/textbook-clion-gui')
app=Path('/tmp/textbook-clion-app/clion-2026.2.3')
props=root/'isolated.properties'
props.write_text('\n'.join(f'idea.{k}.path={root/k}' for k in ['config','system','plugins','log'])+'\n')
vm=root/'clion64.vmoptions'
vm.write_text((app/'bin/clion64.vmoptions').read_text().replace('-Dawt.toolkit.name=auto','-Dawt.toolkit.name=XToolkit'))
fd_read,fd_write=os.pipe()
xvfb=subprocess.Popen(['Xvfb','-displayfd',str(fd_write),'-screen','0','1600x1000x24'],pass_fds=(fd_write,),start_new_session=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
os.close(fd_write)
if not select.select([fd_read],[],[],10)[0]:raise TimeoutError('Xvfb startup')
display=os.read(fd_read,100).decode().strip();os.close(fd_read)
env=dict(os.environ,DISPLAY=':'+display,QT_QPA_PLATFORM='xcb',XDG_CONFIG_HOME=str(root/'xdg-config'),XDG_CACHE_HOME=str(root/'xdg-cache'),XDG_DATA_HOME=str(root/'xdg-data'),XDG_STATE_HOME=str(root/'xdg-state'),CLION_PROPERTIES=str(props),CLION_VM_OPTIONS=str(vm),XDG_SESSION_TYPE='x11',ROS_DOMAIN_ID='191',ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE='LOCALHOST',ROS_LOG_DIR=str(root/'ros-logs'))
env.pop('WAYLAND_DISPLAY',None)
log=(root/'clion-stdout.txt').open('w')
actions=(root/'actions.jsonl').open('a')
ide=subprocess.Popen(['dbus-run-session','--',str(app/'bin/clion.sh'),str(root/'ide-demo')],env=env,start_new_session=True,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
def run(argv):return subprocess.run(argv,env=env,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
def shot(name):
 run(['xwd','-root','-silent','-out',str(root/(name+'.xwd'))]);print(json.dumps({'snapshot':name,'path':str(root/(name+'.xwd'))}),flush=True)
try:
 time.sleep(12);print(json.dumps({'ready':True,'display':display,'folder':str(root),'launcher_status':ide.poll()}),flush=True);shot('startup')
 for line in sys.stdin:
  item=json.loads(line);actions.write(json.dumps(item)+'\n');actions.flush()
  if item.get('quit'):break
  if 'keys' in item:run(['xdotool','key',*item['keys'].split()])
  if 'text' in item:run(['xdotool','type','--clearmodifiers',item['text']])
  if 'click' in item:
   x,y=item['click'];run(['xdotool','mousemove',str(x),str(y),'click',str(item.get('button',1))])
  time.sleep(item.get('wait',1));shot(item['name'])
finally:
 for proc in [ide,xvfb]:
  if proc.poll() is None:
   os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
   try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGKILL);proc.wait()
 actions.close();log.close()
